item.title: Attorney General Ellison’s office raises concerns about energy costs and transparency regarding Google’s Pine Island data center
item.description:
Publication Date: October 01, 2026

AG’s Office notes costs may rise into ‘billions’ for Xcel ratepayers who are supposed to be insulated by law from all data center electricity costs

item.title: Attorney General Ellison sues Refocus Recovery and former founder for breaches of fiduciary duties, violations of nonprofit laws
item.description:
Publication Date: October 01, 2026

In civil lawsuit, accuses sham nonprofit of creating conflicts of interest, Dan Larson of improperly creating Refocus Recovery as passthrough to funnel Medicaid funds to Kyros for-profit corporations for personal benefit
